summary: The proposal contains several serious methodological and compliance issues, notably a disallowed documentation task in the schedule and missing details in the AI transparency statement. Minor formatting errors are also present, indicating the need for substantial revisions before submission.

findings.title: Inclusion of thesis writing/documentation task
findings.description: Iteration 9 lists a generic ‘Documentation’ task, which is a thesis writing activity and lacks measurable specifics, violating the rule that the schedule must not contain thesis or documentation writing tasks.

findings.title: Missing sections in AI transparency statement
findings.description: The AI transparency statement does not specify which sections of the proposal the AI tools were used for, which is required by the guidelines.

locations.section: Transparency in the Use of AI Tools
locations.quote: **In preparing this proposal, I made use of several AI-based tools across different stages of the writing process.**

findings.title: Horizontal layer tasks without vertical integration (Iterations 1 & 2)
findings.description: Iteration 1 focuses on modularizing the existing system instead of delivering an end‑to‑end, vertically integrated feature, violating the requirement for vertically integrated deliverables. Iteration 2 implements a core feedback generation pipeline and defines contracts but does not produce a complete, usable feature, representing a horizontal split rather than a vertically integrated deliverable.

locations.quote: •   **Modularize Thesis Management** to prepare integration of the feedback module (Objective 4)

findings.title: Heading capitalization error
findings.description: The heading "4.4 Integrate With Thesis Management" does not follow title case conventions: the preposition "With" is incorrectly capitalized.
